senses.gloss: m.(b. h. לָמַד)teaching, learning, study (interch. with תלמוד); training; habit.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 40b:8">Kidd. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>ל׳ גדול שהל׳ וכ׳</he> study is more (than practice), for study leads to practice; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 17a">B. Kam. 17ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 27a:15">Meg. 27ᵃ</cite> (Ms. M. <cite ref="V00601"><he>תלמוד</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Horayot 13a:18">Hor. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>משכחים את הל׳</he> cause man to forget what he has learned; <cite ref="Horayot 13b:13">ib. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>משיב ל׳ וכ׳</he> brings back to recollection the study of seventy years.
Ex. R. s. 43 לשון ל׳ (the root ירה in Hif.) means to teach.

<cite ref="Berakhot 7b:26">Ber. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>גדולה … יותר מלִמּוּדָהּ</he> the ministrations (of the disciples to the doctors) of the Law are more valuable than the direct teaching of it. Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 1 <he>מבקש לִמּוּדוֹ וכ׳</he> he seeks for the enjoyments to which he has been used and fails to find them; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="L00480"><he>לִימּוּדִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="L00480"><he>לִימּוּדִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="L00480"><he>לִמּ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 65b:19">Snh. 65ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 918:3">Yalk. Deut. 918</cite> (expl. <he>מעונן</he>, v. <cite ref="P00291"><he>עוּן</he></cite>) (who says) <he>לִימּוּדֵי … חטין יפות</he> it is usual for the wheat crops to be fine in the ante-Sabbatical years; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:1">Tosef. Sabb. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:14">VIII</cite>), 14; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 171:9">Sifré Deut. 171</cite> <he>ל׳ … להיות יפות</he> the ante-Sabbatical years are usually good (in crops); Sifra K’dosh. Par. 3, ch. VI <he>לְמוּדוֹת … להיות יפות</he>.
